title: compose ticket steps chain git commands with &&, which the work skill forbids and permissions block
body: What happened: compose 'No task id' step 4 tells the agent to run 'git -C <main> add -- <paths> && git -C <main> commit ...' as one command. The work skill says never chain commands, and in this session such chained commands needed manual approval and were blocked in a non-interactive run. Expected: the compose steps give two separate commands (add, then commit). Steps: follow compose 'No task id' or 'Plan an epic' step 5 literally. Evidence: the instruction text above; my chained rm/git add/git commit call was refused with 'multiple operations ... requires approval' and I had to split it.
note: Accepted. Planned for a coming release.
